[h1]⚔️ Welcome to the fray, Knights! ⚔️[/h1]
[b]We are very excited to announce that Good Night, Knight is now available in Early Access! [/b]

A dynamic sneak-and-slash RPG that mixes procedural generation with hand-made scenarios and a darkly humorous story. Created almost entirely by just one developer (!) game features heavy-hitting deliberate combat, robust stealth mechanics, threatening enemies with unique movesets and a vast array of game-changing items to discover.

[h1]Good Night, Knight is now 20% OFF![/h1]

Of course, it’s just the beginning of the adventure. Even though Good Night, Knight is already packed with features, we have new areas and challenges planned for players. Today we're revealing our roadmap with an overview of some of the planned major updates!

It’s a cRPG set in a world of cats dressed in funny costumes, full of cat magic, triis, gods and other cat-centric stuff. Humour, memes and pop culture references are the pillars of this production.

[i]The Chronicles of Nyanya[/i] tell a story about Catair, whose heart and face are permanently marked by her dark, dramatic past. Now, she must journey to places that she didn’t want to go to and talk to cats whom she never wanted to meet... Yet, she has no other choice, because her adventourist internship won’t complete itself. On her journey, she will have a chance to become a part of an epic war between cats and an army of Nazi furniture, make a choice between following the voice of friendship or letting emo take over her heart, and also raise an orphan kaiser roll to become a true pastry warrior or… something else.

notes.title: Soundscapes painted with purr
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30712289/cbc2c6b97e9cc731f84cb22d4a25ac757b8ee0b7.jpg[/img]
There is this very unfair and prejudiced phrase in the Polish language called "kocia muzyka". You can roughly translate it to "cat's music". It means that this particular music doesn't sound too great, that it's more like a loud racket than real music.

But, dammit! It's not true and it's racist as hell! First of all, we cats are very talented and devoted to our music. You can say it's like second nature to us! Second of all, I know what you are thinking. Paws would be a bit problematic if one were to dream of becoming a world famous instrumentalist. Alas, overcoming adversity is our forte! Nothing, I say nothing is impossible for a committed cat with a well defined objective in his life. Are you familiar with  the Keyboard Cat? No?! And you call yourself a fan of music? You probably don't even know Catman John either.

Regardless of your naivety, we have done everything in our power to ensure the soundtrack for [i]The Chronicles of Nyanya[/i] would be the most epic, purrific and engaging OST you've ever heard. The tracks were composed by the one and only Marcin Maślanka – renown sound designer, composer, musician, keyboardist and cat lover. Some tracks are so touching, they make our inner cat purr. I’ve even brought you a small sample – listen:
https://youtu.be/57JlDFpMcuU

The Chronicles of Nyana will be out on 16th Furrbruary, so purrease add it to your wishlist to enjoy the game and the soundtrack in all it's full orchestral glory!

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30712289/cbc2c6b97e9cc731f84cb22d4a25ac757b8ee0b7.jpg[/img]
[b]In this game there's no lion, but there are definitely witches. And a wardrobe, but not what you might expect. The upcoming retro-style jRPG The Chronicles of Nyanya is full of delicious silliness.[/b]

In a game full of cats you don't expect the theme of existential nihilism to take away the will to live and fight. But it's there, countered by friendship. The underlayer of philosophical and social commentary is light and funny, like the whole game, but worth noting. The main protagonist, Catair, is female and regularly hears sexist remarks. notes.title: The Eccentricities of The Chronicles of Nyanya: Pop and meme culture connections
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30712289/cbc2c6b97e9cc731f84cb22d4a25ac757b8ee0b7.jpg[/img]
[b][i]In this game there's no lion, but there are definitely witches. And a wardrobe, but not what you might expect. The upcoming retro-style jRPG The Chronicles of Nyanya is full of delicious silliness.[/i][/b]

I'm sure you’ve noticed it by now: familiar sounding names and places. If you're into comic books, internet memes or pop culture in general, The Chronicles of Nyanya is literally made for you. You meet a cute florist named Cateris there, and a snake reciting a snippet from Blade Runner. You can speak with Granny Weathercat, Furry Catter and Nyoda. You see many guards who took an arrow in the knee, and hear that war never changes. In other games such jokes are rare Easter eggs – in The Chronicles of Nyanya, it’s one enormous omelet.

notes.title: The Eccentricities of The Chronicles of Nyanya: Cats. Cats are nice
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30712289/cbc2c6b97e9cc731f84cb22d4a25ac757b8ee0b7.jpg[/img]
[b]In this game there's no lion, but there are definitely witches. And a wardrobe, but not what you might expect. The upcoming retro-style jRPG The Chronicles of Nyanya is full of delicious silliness.[/b]

The core of Hamstercube studio consists of two unconventional individuals. Ilona Myszkowska and Adrian Pskiet speak a strange language full of twisted words, memes and inside jokes. The Chronicles of Nyanya is a reflection of their world. A fantasy jRPG with cute handmade graphics, the game offers a story about meowbarian purriors, battle pastries and Nazi furniture.

Nyanya is a feline world and this means cats of all shapes and sizes - and classes. The main protagonist, Catair, is a meowsassin, for example. And Meowdledore, one of her reluctant companions, is a meowmage with the magic power of light side of the Yarn Ball of Force at his disposal. On their adventures, the fellowship of adventourists fight with green orcats in the forests, brawl with drowncats in the swamps, and battle ghostcats in the dungeons. Craziness!

notes.title: 6 main characters revealed!
notes.content:
Hi All!

We have a sneak peak of the game's main characters: 
[olist]
[*]Catair Meowchiha, 
[*]Francat Furtzinger,
[*]Purrgli, son of Purrin,
[*]Catniss Everpurr,
[*]Meowdledore Voldemeow,
[*]Purrevar Do'Meowden
[/olist]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30712289/169a8688d7cf8b61557e576e58491ca4682c2c97.png[/img]

One may get the impression that [b]Catair[/b] is a professional loser, but no - she is a meowsassin of the Order of the Moving Red Dot. Her claws bring havoc, terror and high damage.
Her difficult childhood has left an imprint of trauma on her fragile heart, turning her into a dark, emo avenger of hatred and an emotional eater.

************

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30712289/6588586c5a95e72124a1719332c5264c8bf2ed8b.png[/img]

An experienced clericat of the Goddess of the Great Bowl of Goodness. He has a host of divine powers at his disposal, ranging from healing-petting psalms to ravaging slipper comets (super effective agains smuffinpiders).
He’s a fanatic of magical artifacts and consequently purrsues his aim of cluttering his inventory with legendary items.

************

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30712289/9ec7c65a8dde983c0674d16cd3e7b67c3a9bb51f.png[/img]

The bravest and wisest of the Catmerian purriors, known not only for his great deeds but also as a cover model for “Muscles and Fur” - the magazine for real tomcats.
The might of his blows is matched only by the power of his character. He dreams that one day his legend will surpass that of his father, but that will be pretty hard, as his father’s legend was a pretty huge legend.

************

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30712289/bf48998304e377857a4f87b41b47b9b1d32f652b.png[/img]

[b]Catniss[/b] is an archer and the champion of the goddess of archery, Meowrida the Brave. She was raised by ent-cats and she is a long-lost princess, but no one knows about that. 
Catniss treasures friendship. She has a lot of it and she plans to share it with everyone, even if nobody wants any. 
Her best friend - [b]Rollenhwyvar[/b] - is a fighter roll, who aids her in  battle.

************

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30712289/1cfbceb0358a3a9178c2e558a7e4552fbd7d1956.png[/img]

Meowmage, a padawan of the noble art of wielding the light side of the Yarn Ball of Force, apprentice of Nyandalf the White. 
Owner of numerous cool gadgets, with which his disgustingly rich parents try to make up for their lack of attention.
[b]Meowdledore[/b] likes to show off his amazing spells, especially when other cats are watching.

************


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30712289/d509e7705a8e5fc088f586e71c2b79190a489c41.png[/img]

[b]Purrevar[/b] is a black cat and a proud prince of Underpurr. He is also a graduate of the Ultimate Villain High, where he majored in Nemesis Studies. After graduating, he started working as the main enemy of Francat’s team. 
He wields two scimitars of darkness forged with rap music. His best friend is a chocolate pastry smuffinpider who aids him in his battles. Since he wasn’t very creative, he just named the creature “Smuffinpider”.

[b]The Chronicles of Nyanya[/b] will be out on Steam [b]November 16th[/b].
